import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { city } from "../../../backend/schema/city";

export const cityCms = customizeTable<typeof city>("city", {
    display: {
        title: "city"
    },
    sort: ["lastUpdate", "desc"],
    fields: {
        city: {
            multiline: true
        },
        lastUpdate: {
            readOnly: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: ["cityId", "lastUpdate", "country", "city"]
});
